<h3>Cómo se vuela</h3><ul><li><b>Despega:
How to fly

  • Take off: hold Up (Space; ✕ or R2 on the controller).
  • Go forward and turn: joystick forward and sideways; backwards brakes and goes back slowly.
  • Go down: hold Down (Shift; L2 on the controller).
  • Land: come down on a flat spot (ground, flat roofs or the jetty), or press Land and it does it by itself. It won't set down on water or on top of a tree.
  • Cockpit: the Cockpit button puts you inside; Outside goes back to the outside view.
  • With friends: with a friend's aircraft on the ground, go up to it and press Ride with…: 3 passengers fit in the car and 5 in the helicopter. If you jump in mid-flight, you come down by glider.
<h3>Cómo se lee la pantalla</h3><ul><li>:
How to read the screen

  • Height (box on the right): metres above whatever is below you.
  • Round shadow: the point on the ground right below you; it gets darker as you come down.
  • Top left: speed and, in the rings, which one is next and the time.
  • Flight ceiling:

). Hay cuatro <b>coches voladores</b> y: ). There are four flying cars and two helicopters. Next to one, Fly. Hold Up to take off vertically; the joystick goes forward and turns, Down descends, and if you let go of everything the aircraft stays still in the air. You land by coming down on any flat spot (ground, flat roofs, the jetty) or with the Land button, which does it by itself; it won't set down on water or on top of a tree. The Height box is the altimeter and the round shadow marks the ground below you. Cockpit switches to the pilot's view and photo mode works in mid-flight. When you fly the rings in the sky appear: cross the first and go through all ten in order against the clock (the green one is next; there are medals and coins). In a room, your friends see the aircraft and can ride as passengers when it's on the ground (3 in the car, 5 in the helicopter); whoever jumps in the air comes down by glider.
